provenance_notes: Only class A material feeds geometry or evidence: official specification numbers, fitment numbers, CC BY, CC BY SA and CC0 photographs, TapMart's own AI reconstructions.
Class B and C sources (commercial models, press photographs, parts diagrams, configurators, videos) were neither downloaded nor used; they are listed for completeness only.
Every reference carries creator, licence, licence version, source page and a SHA256 of the working copy. Overlays drawn on CC BY SA photographs are shared under the same licence.
The Commons API returned 429 for this container; images came through the Openverse index (which carries the Commons licence metadata) and the Wikimedia upload host at 1280 px.

AI hypotheses (Meshy semantic boundaries) enter the fit at 1 cm = 0.6 px, an order of magnitude below any photograph, and are labelled AI_HYPOTHESIS only where they agree with the fitted curve within 4 cm.
